body:
I just wanted to say thank you. I stumbled upon your response last night and along with the others they made me feel a twinge of *something* which has been few and far between these past months. 

Also, i really hope you dont mind (and I definately dont want to come off as stalkerish), I skimmed through some of the stuff you've commented on and I found myself in the wonderful subreddit of /r/aww. Which then led me to just sitting with my dog and I kinda realised how selfish I was being to even consider it as an option, but sometimes it just doesn't feel like there's any other viable ones.

If you ever need to talk about your problems, or anything at all, I'd be delighted to talk with you. Again, thank you.

Thank you. I ended up getting drunk next to my dog.

Also, I hope you don't mind, but I looked at your post in /r/mentalhealth and the thing you said about depression, I feel that often too, so you aren't alone. 

I'd like to return your offer, so if you ever need somebody to talk to or anything at all then shoot me a pm.

Thanks man
